dotween.notes: Modules asmdef and DOTweenSettings.asset were authored by hand instead of the Utility Panel. Settings are stored in DOTween/Resources (storeSettingsLocation=1). Do not regenerate the asmdef from the Utility Panel: it would drop the hand-written UnityEngine.UI reference. DOTween's editor adds its own DOTWEEN define to every platform group on first load; that is expected.

testAssemblyNote: BK.Kit.EditModeTests uses overrideReferences=true with precompiledReferences [nunit.framework.dll, DOTween.dll]; the legacy optionalUnityReferences form did not pick up DOTween.dll.
